entries.name: Fast Movement (MNK)
entries.description:
At 3rd level, a monk gains an enhancement bonus to his land speed, as seen below. A monk in armor or carrying a medium or heavy load loses this extra speed.

Starting LevelBonus Speed
3+10 ft.
6+20 ft.
9+30 ft.
12+40 ft.
15+50 ft.
18+60 ft.

entries.name: Trap Sense
entries.description: At 3rd level, this character gains a +1 bonus on Reflex saves made to avoid traps and a +1 dodge bonus to armor class against attacks made by traps. These bonuses increase by +1 every three levels thereafter (6th, 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th level). Trap sense bonuses gained from multiple classes stack.
